summary: The northern border is becoming unstable. General Arden has recently started collecting mana potions. Ash Valley is at risk because of the growing conflict. Nearby villages may soon face medicine shortages.
known_events: General Arden requested a large amount of mana potions for an unnamed military operation.
Merchants reported that mana-related supplies are becoming harder to buy.
Travelers mentioned smoke, soldiers, and blocked roads near the northern route.
hidden_truth: General Arden's military operation may later cause serious damage to Ash Valley. Earlier supply quests may indirectly worsen the refugee and medicine crisis.
